description: This file defines the React component 'CartPage' which manages the shopping cart view in an e-commerce application. It handles loading cart items, updating quantities, removing items, and displaying the total.

methods.name: CartPage()
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the shopping cart page, managing cart state, loading data, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches cart data from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item via API call.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart by setting its quantity to zero.
